page.overview:
Who is Andrew Thomas Cohnely?

Andrew Thomas "Dirty" Cohnely was a human male. Cohnely used to work for the Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations where his impeccable service allowed him to rapidly rise through the ranks, even earning him an Imperial Medal of Honor. However, his career ended after an investigation into the Camarina Connection revealed to him that the gang's activities were covered up by those in power. Disgusted by this realization, he resigned after shortly after Councillor Wan Tyrama "committed suicide." After his resignation, Cohnely worked at Spaceport 16 on the planet Abregado Rae where he served as security chief of the spaceport's security service with the rank of major. He lived alone with his pet Jabba Gooey, a giant slug from the planet Dagobah.
